summary_1line: Yudhishthira contemplates performing the Rajasuya sacrifice, rules a prosperous and harmonious kingdom, consults advisers, and considers seeking Krishna’s guidance.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira sits in his royal sabha surrounded by brothers, sages, and ministers while discussing the great Rajasuya sacrifice.
The five Pandava brothers govern together—Bhima judging firmly, Arjuna guarding the borders, Nakula humble among the people, and Sahadeva dispensing impartial justice.
Prosperous fields under abundant rain spread across Yudhishthira’s peaceful kingdom as citizens work contentedly without fear or conflict.
